notes.title: First Date With An Empress (U0.3.1)

[b]Hi :)[/b]

We’ve missed you. But this is no time for sentimentality, let’s announce what we’ve prepared. 

Up first is our main event for this update: a delightful first date with the Empress of Diamond Straits herself: Nile!

Featuring new animations, new voice lines, and even a couple of new tracks to set the mood, this new date will let you get to know the royal feline like never before, so be sure to check it out, assuming you haven’t stood Sammy up last time. It’s rude to leave one lady waiting; leaving two is a felony. 

We’ve also added some new items to the gachapon machine, lovingly crafted by our resident artist, and ready to find their homes in your inventory before being sent off to your favorite girls. There’s some old favorites, and there might be a few surprises that you don’t expect. With enough luck, you might just discover them. 

Alongside these content updates, we’ve also improved the graphics quality across all the levels as part of our ongoing quest to make everything the prettiest and smoothest it can be. 

As always, we are already working on the next content patch as we launch this one, so look forward to more content coming in the future! :)

Take care, and happy hunting.

notes.title: The Better Than Sex Update: Dating + Gallery! (U0.3)
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

As mentioned in the last set of (proper) Patch Notes, the next update would be the big one. 
Well, here it is! [strike]Just ignore those Hotfix ones btw.[/strike]

Anyway, let's get right into it.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Dating[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271935/8a58df0d5324daf65727f5b55143fb092a9fdad6.jpg[/img]
First and foremost, [i]dates[/i] have arrived on the island. 

Go meet with Prinny (who is making her main game debut) and she’ll tell you all about it. 

These dates are going to be a mainstay feature of the game moving forward, with many more planned, and another already in development for release with the next update. 

Get to know your favorite girls, and enjoy the most quality time you’ve gotten with them so far.

Dates contain a lot of written dialogue and character specific animations, as well as a good number of new voicelines to let their personalities shine. 

There’s also some new lewd content (with special content for those who wish to keep things tame.)

Currently, there is only one date available (with Sammy), but more are on their way!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Store[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271935/a9f7d33ac1fb4b96c95ca6e68ad3ba82bb72e509.jpg[/img]
If you’re going to date a lady, you’re going to have to learn how to treat her right. 

With this in mind, welcome to the [b]Store[/b]!

Using tokens that you can find in the Nightclub and Security Office, you can try your luck to secure the gifts that your girls have been waiting for. 

This system is still being worked on, so you can’t go full Casanova [i]just[/i] yet. However, there’s nothing wrong with amassing a little pile of goodies for your favorites.

Oh, and please don't make fun of me being poor.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Gallery[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271935/392e94d7f19e5e135159fb57879fef6a92c0ce64.jpg[/img]
You’ve been pestering us for it, and here it finally is!

A new gallery has been added, featuring all the animations you know and love, as well as a neat new free-cam that lets you get right where you want to be in the action. 

But, if you want to see everything, you’ll have to [i]play[/i] everything, so be sure to get through the Nightclub and Security Office to unlock all of the animations!

This is a new style of gallery than what we’ve done before, but we’re very happy with it, and hope you all enjoy it as much as we do. 

Just don’t hold it against us if you fly right up a character’s nose and they look funny. 

The old media gallery still exists, so don’t worry about missing out on all of those animations either, it’s just tucked safely away in the extras menu. 

Which leads us into…

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Title Screen[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271935/e16a5929c70d16100ae4e1f5d8815fa9baffc089.jpg[/img]
Our VCR went to the repair shop and never came back, so welcome to the new title screen and menus for IN HEAT: Lustful Nights!

Due to the sheer number of new systems and menus added in this update, we found it a bit hard getting everything integrated into the old title screen without just throwing everything on the monitor. Therefore we decided to rebuild it from the ground up with ample space should we ever require even more menus!

With new music, new options, and a significant increase in Sammy eye contact, we hope you’ll find this menu to be a bit more responsive than before.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Lighting[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271935/cd75adc5dc69d3170b0dc2c5f302bcd50e74fc08.jpg[/img]
Everyone loves lights, and we're experimenting with some new ones 😎

The game now relies far less on realtime lighting, opting for baked lighting instead. 
Even Unity was telling us that we were overdoing it before so here we are.

This should generally improve performance and overall just provide more consistent visuals. 
We’re still testing things out and tweaking some areas, so expect adjustments and even better-looking scenes in the future!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Save Upgrade[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42271935/8cf1331165c2cadd6cfa6a538a369a7879041d0f.jpg[/img]
Bad news time! Can't only have good ones :(

Due to various new systems tracking player progress being added, the savestate of every game will need to be upgraded. Aaaaand this includes a progress reset. 

This should however be the first [i]and[/i] last time we have to do something like this, so that's good news I guess?

Just to make sure people are aware of this change there'll be a big spooky disclaimer warning you that your save data will be reset, in case you want to save it beforehand.

Here's some top secret information for those actually reading this. You can find the savestate under one of the following:
[list]
[*] Windows: %userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\MonsterBox\IN HEAT
[*] Linux: ~/.config/unity3d/MonsterBox/IN HEAT
[*] Mac: MacAppSupport\MonsterBox\IN HEAT
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

No separate changelog this time. It'd be a bit long.
Bug fixes and stuff ya know. The usual.

Fun Fact: This update contained 700 commits, which I'm sure will mean something to someone. 
That's roughly 31% of the total commits for the game :)

As always we'd like to thank you all for your continued support of this project and we hope you're looking forward for what's to come next!

Now it's back into the mines for us to continue work on the next update.

[b]XOXO MonsterBox[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes 2025-02-17 (U0.2.9.3)
notes.content:
Fixed Textures not appearing / randomly disappearing. This issue seems to have been most prevalent in the Nightclub, although we've seen some reports for the Title Screen & Security Office.

We couldn't replicate this issue on any of our machines so the fix is based on feedback from some Users that did run into this issue.

[hr][/hr]
We've also added some new options to the Settings:
[list]
[*] Automatic Bug Reporting
[*] Configurable MSAA Level
[/list]
Bug reporting is completely optional and sends us anonymized data whenever an error occurs in our code. By default bug reporting is disabled.

Collected data includes the player's GPU's name, its VRAM, and the exception itself.
It's often the case that we aren't able to replicate some of the issues that users are facing so this data can help out a lot. The collected data is going straight to us and isn't being stored anywhere else.

Aside from that the MSAA Level is now configurable for all quality levels. 
Previously MSAA (4x) was only enabled on the "High" Quality setting.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2024-07-01 (U0.2.3)
notes.content:
We've just published a new update containing various performance improvements and balancing changes.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

[h1]Performance[/h1]

The performance within Cameras in the Nightclub should be a lot better now.
From our testing on a Steam Deck the average FPS went up from ~34FPS to 60FPS+ on Medium Settings.
The Security Office Cameras didn't seem to be affected by this issue.

We've also adjusted some things regarding what is being rendered and when it is being rendered which should slightly bring down the GPU Usage across the entire game.

We'll keep looking into performance issues in the future!

[h1]Features[/h1]
